declarations.description:
A browsable Bikram Sambat (Nepali) month calendar rendered as native DOM, so it works in React,
Vue, Angular, Svelte, and plain HTML.

Where `<nepali-date-picker>` asks for a date, this one is read: it shows both calendars' numbers
and the neighbouring months' days by default, marks the days an institution is closed for, and
can write the picked day and the month's events out under the grid.

The grid is the picker's own, so a day looks the same on both. All calendar math comes from
`@nepali-date-picker/core`, the same engine the Kotlin, Android and Python builds use.
declarations.name: NepaliCalendar

declarations.name: digitScript
declarations.description: The numeral script a language writes its digits in, as the engine names it.

declarations.name: toIso
declarations.description: Format a date as a zero-padded `YYYY-MM-DD` string (Latin digits).

declarations.name: parseIso
declarations.description:
Parse a `YYYY-MM-DD` (or `YYYY/MM/DD`) date string into a [CalendarDate].

Devanagari digits are accepted and folded to Latin first. Returns `null` for empty or malformed
input; range validity against the calendar is the caller's responsibility.

declarations.name: sameDate
declarations.description: Structural equality for two dates, tolerating `null`.

declarations.name: parseWeeklyOffDays
declarations.description:
Parse the `weekly-off-days` attribute: a comma-separated list of weekday numbers, 1 for Sunday
through 7 for Saturday.

JavaScript numbers Sunday `0` and this calendar numbers it `1`, so a `0` is dropped rather than
quietly closing Sunday. An unparseable value yields an empty week, which closes nothing.

declarations.name: parseEvents
declarations.description:
Parse the `events` attribute or property: JSON text, or an array already.

An entry without a usable `date` is dropped, and so is anything that is not an array at all, so a
malformed attribute leaves the calendar plain instead of throwing inside a render.

An entry carrying `endDate` or `days` is expanded here into one entry per day of its span, which
is what lets everything downstream keep reading a day at a time.

declarations.name: eventKindOf
declarations.description: The kind an entry names, falling back to `observance` for anything unrecognized.

declarations.name: closesOffices
declarations.description: Whether an entry shuts the institution: its own flag, else what its kind usually means.

declarations.name: kindPriority
declarations.description: How strongly a kind describes a day when several land on it, lowest first.
